svg.title: IFINDIT DATA CATALOG: data governance and end-to-end traceability
svg.desc: IFINDIT DATA CATALOG illustration focused on data governance and traceability in a public entity. At the top, the governance layer defines for the BENEFICIARIES asset its owner (Planning Office) and custodian (IT Office), the business term “Active beneficiary”, targeting rule RN-021 and the policies of Colombian Laws 1581 of 2012 and 1712 of 2014. In the middle, end-to-end traceability: SISBÉN IV as the source, loading into LakeHouse, validation with 98.7% valid records, a certified asset with 97% quality, and consumption in the management dashboard and in anonymised open data. At the bottom, an audit log records who did what and when, and an impact analysis warns that changing rule RN-021 affects 3 dashboards and 1 open dataset. A map below places Data Catalog on the Auth IAM and LakeHouse base and shows that its data feeds ChatGen and the Dashboards.
